title: Recipe Book is Pain (Extended)
description: A port of Recipe Book is Pain to newer versions, along with new features.
body:
<details>
<summary>中文页面</summary>
此项目已合并入Better Recipe Book (Extended)。

---
  
这是[Recipe Book is Pain](https://modrinth.com/mod/rbip)的非官方分支，旨在高版本迁移与拓展功能（不改变核心功能）。

# 核心功能
将创造模式物品栏的分组应用于配方书。在游玩大型整合包时能帮助你更快寻找配方。
![Recipe Book is Pain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f676e8567f877f2bbeb840d14479d1b364a0a30f.webp)
 - 这张截图来自[Recipe Book is Pain](https://modrinth.com/mod/rbip)的官方页面。

# 拓展功能
1. 新增配方书上侧和下侧的标签页。
![示例](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4adb7596ccd3bd1d719729be078cd7494dd6e6dc.png)  
2. 使用鼠标滚轮翻页。
3. 搜索页常驻。

## 配置`config\recipe-book-is-pain-extended.json`
1. 将"extended_features"改为false来禁用拓展功能。
2. 修改"bottom_number"的值来改变显示的标签页的数量，最大16（如同图片展示的那样），最小6（原版）。

</details>


<details>
<summary>English page</summary>
This project has been integrated into Better Recipe Book (Extended).

---
  
This is an unofficial fork of [Recipe Book is Pain](https://modrinth.com/mod/rbip), intended for migration to newer versions and feature expansion without changing the core functionality.

# Core Features

Apply the creative-mode inventory grouping to the recipe book. When playing large modpacks, this helps you find recipes more quickly.

![Recipe Book is Pain](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f676e8567f877f2bbeb840d14479d1b364a0a30f.webp)

- This screenshot is from the official page of [Recipe Book is Pain](https://modrinth.com/mod/rbip).

# Extended Features
1. Added top and bottom tabs to the recipe book.
![Example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4adb7596ccd3bd1d719729be078cd7494dd6e6dc.png)  
2. Scroll with the mouse wheel to turn pages.
3. Sticky Search Page.

## Configuration `config\recipe-book-is-pain-extended.json`
1. Set `"extended_features"` to `false` to disable the extended features.
2. Modify the value of `"bottom_number"` to change the number of displayed tabs, maximum 16 (as shown in the image), minimum 6 (vanilla).

</details>
